featured_reviews.name: vaibhav kothare
featured_reviews.review_text:
My 2 years long House Hunt finally saw it's destination @ Chandak Paloma.
At the very beginning we were kind of unsure of the buy but a special mention to our Sales Representative Mr Nikhil Chitroda who made us quite comfortable and helped/guided us a lot before we were sure of closing the deal.
He was available anytime, while we were still contemplating for a few months he was giving us constant updates of the development of the project which actually kept us interested in the project, he is very much approachable person indeed.

About the Premises -

If you have to ask me my opinion the builder actually delivers.
The building looks quite a sight post completion.

Location -

Centrally located, quite close to Station as well as WEH, just that have to walk 3-4 mins for General day to day shopping/ATM's unlike my previous place where in I use to get everything just below my building.

Amenities -

It's has all that is needed in the society Premises be it a Swimming Pool or a Well Made Gymnasium or Kids Playing Area.
Everything is really well made, just that now it has to be maintained the same way so as the beautification to be intact.

Internal Flat Amenities -

Here in the amenities are quite less, may be our expectations were more in here.
Fans & Lights is still ok to not be there as everyone has their own taste and would want it accordingly but Grills was what we thought that the builder should have packaged with the cost as it's a standard pattern which has to be installed and there is no scope for any kind of difference there, that would have made us felt even more nice but nonetheless.

Parking -

It's a Stack Parking arrangement where in as of now the builder has arranged for a Valet service which takes care but very frankly the area is quite cramped for my liking as it allows limited movement in the parking area and is somewhat a challenge to park your car but may be as you get used to it you would feel more comfortable.

Security -

As of now the security arrangements are quite prompt. Feel safe in the premises.

People -

The people here are quite helpful and understanding.
Right from the Project Architects to our Sales Representatives.
Again a special mention to Mr. Sandeep & Mr. Rashesh for all their help and much needed guidance which really helped us through the buying cycle and also post that.

Support Staff -

The Support staff also always has a smile on their faces while serving snacks or Tea/coffee which creates a right environment.
Special Mention for Mr Vishal here.

After Sales Service -

Usually what happens is once the purchase is made the people tend to care less.
But in this case it was very different.
Post the purchase as well we didn't find any difference in the approach of the people around, they were just the same with us.
Mr Nikhil has really been very helpful since Day 1 till date and i am sure it will stay that way.

Im glad we picked this project for us to stay.
Hope everything stays quite the same.

Cheers !!
Vaibhav

Response from WestinRely Developers Pvt. Ltd.
We acknowledge the concerns raised by one of the shop owners regarding the redevelopment project being undertaken by WestinRely Developers Pvt. Ltd. We would like to provide the following clarifications in response:

1. Scheme and Legality.
The redevelopment is being carried out in full compliance with applicable laws and under valid permissions. While the land is privately owned, the project has been undertaken as per guidelines of Development control regulations 2034. (DCR 2034) framework, with due process being followed. Necessary permissions and NOCs have either been obtained or are in the process of being obtained as per regulatory timelines.

2. Consent and Society Approval.

As clearly documented in the attached registered agreement (refer to page with thumb impressions and society resolution dated 18/12/2022), the Society's General Body Meeting (SGBM) approved the allocation of flats and commercial premises. The agreement also outlines the location of new flats and commercial units and confirms the builder’s responsibility to allot premises only after satisfying the entitlement of all original members.
The builder has not acted unilaterally, and this document (attached) includes executing members’ signatures and biometric confirmations, further establishing that decisions were made transparently with society participation.

3. Ground Floor Commercial Shop.

The concern regarding the ground floor commercial unit being constructed for sale is misplaced. As per Clause 7.3 of the agreement, commercial premises for members are to be allotted on the first floor, as agreed by the society. The balance premises, i.e., any remaining built-up space after member entitlements have been honored, are within the developer's legal right to utilize and dispose of.
It is important to note that:
•	The entitlement of the original shop members has been fulfilled as per agreed plans.
•	The ground floor unit is part of the developer’s share, clearly permissible under the agreement signed with the society.
4. Litigation and Injunction
We would like to clarify that no injunction, as claimed, has been issued by the court. There is no stay order or injunction preventing the sale or construction of any commercial unit within the project. Any claims regarding such an injunction are incorrect and do not reflect the true status of the legal proceedings.
We are actively cooperating with the legal process and are confident that the court will recognize our adherence to lawful procedures and contractual obligations.

5. Blackmail and Coercion.

It is important to clarify that the legal actions and demands made by Ibrahim and Hanif Chokiya and their legal heir are without basis and seem to be a direct attempt to coerce the company into yielding to unjust demands. The screenshot (refer to the attached image) reflects their unreasonable demands, which are part of a pattern of harassment initiated after they signed the original agreement almost two years ago. Despite having agreed to the terms at the time, they now seek to use legal threats as a tool to obtain more than their entitled share, thereby putting undue pressure on the project and its stakeholders.
Their actual entitlement is 307 sft, it is specifically mentioned in the agreement that any extra area over and above the entitled area is payable. Total payment due for payment is INR 14924450.00 the idea behind all these tactics is to avoid making payment. We shall be proceeding with all legal remedies available at our end to recover our dues and will not settle under any undue pressure. They have approached underworld dons to threaten us. We have all the media evidence available at our end and following up with Mumbai police for filing of FIR under relevant section of BNS.
WestinRely Developers is committed to delivering this project with full transparency, legal compliance, and in the best interests of both the society and future buyers.

Sincerely,
WestinRely Developers Pvt. Ltd.
Legal & Compliance Department
